item.title: New indictment alleges Nick Reiner was lying in wait before killing his parents
item.description: A grand jury has indicted Nick Reiner on murder charges in the killings of his parents, Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner, and adds the allegation that he was lying in wait before attacking them.

item.title: 3 men set for lethal injection on same day in Tennessee, Alabama and Oklahoma
item.description: Three men in Tennessee, Alabama and Oklahoma are scheduled for lethal injection Thursday in a rare convergence of executions on the same day in the U.S.

item.title: Budget cuts have reduced efforts to find and recover Vietnam War troops
item.description: Budget cuts have gutted the Pentagon's efforts to find and identify troops still missing from the Vietnam War, even as aging family members run out of time to see their loved ones brought home.

item.title: Months after being evacuated from Bahrain, military families await their next move
item.description: Sailors and family members who were evacuated from U.S. bases in the Middle East months ago are waiting for the military to figure out what will happen to the lives they left behind.

item.title: What immigration enforcement looks like when police are deputized to do ICE work
item.description: A sheriff in the Florida panhandle has gone all in on federal immigration enforcement. The state rewarded his department with almost $9 million in incentives.

item.title: Andrew Tate's extradition fight tests his influence with Trump's America
item.description: After President Trump took office, Andrew Tate proclaimed, "The Tates will be free." A year later, Tate is being held in federal prison after he was arrested following a U.K. extradition request.

item.title: Former U.S. Marine back home after being held in Russia for over four years
item.description: A former U.S. Marine is home after more than four years in a Russian prison. President Trump says Robert Gilman was freed on humanitarian grounds after supporters raised concerns about his health.
